selection: minimum normal SELECT mean energy loss at 0 and every300; earlier ties
normal_gate: context_only selected update > 0 and SELECT energy strictly below its own step0; no population calibration guarantee
noise_policy: fixed CPU normal draws shared across points, runs, arms and minibatches; independent banks by seed; training iid paired draws from restored identical train RNG
distance: L2 of 4x4 FIT-scaled response / sqrt16 + L2 of log1p absolute ortho rFFT over4 times / sqrt12; retain DC; no window centering
training_objective: mean distance(target, draw) - 0.5 mean distance(independent paired draws)
score: -log((1 + number of normal probe energies >= observed energy)/(255+1)); common pair penalty cancelled for ranking but raw energy retained
single_factor: context_only zeroes four actual response-history slots, response_feedback uses them; both retain five legal past context slots; same parameter tensors/init/FIT plan/loss/score
calibration: existing normal CAL same axis, 0.99 higher quantile, strict >, unchanged third-point-onward C3; no QUERY fitting
scope: single-seed same-simulator G36 mechanism study; no real independent confirmation or contamination robustness
